d:
Some guy had already posted an MTL of this doujin, back when I had uploaded my GalKatsu MTL.
However, it was pretty crap, especially the typesetting, so I was anyway planning on redoing it.
This time I did not use Ichigo reader since its still stuck on gtp4o-mini and there are way better models out there now.
I used a tool by meangrinch, shoutout to the man (https://github.com/meangrinch/MangaTranslator) which allowed me to use llama-3.3-70b-versatile and qwen3-32b. With some shared work between the two and randomly checking some text on Grok, concluded with some rewriting on my end, this turned out to be a way more readable version, save for a few spots where the inpainting really fucked up, despite tweaking a lot of the factors.

I'll most probably work on the Teacher x Gyaru one by Zarameccho next and then redo GalKatsu and Part of 2 Fetio's Soccer Doujin - the MTLs that I had previously uploaded.

The bonus nude pic was edited by Grok, just for the heck of it.

Happy Reading!
-WS
